name: Printy
tagline: A shop hand for your 3D printer: find or draw models, slice, print, troubleshoot.
description: Treat it like the attendant at a print shop. Ask for a part and it either tracks down a suitable model or drafts one, slices it for your specific machine, and kicks off the job after its safety checks pass. When a print fails halfway it stays on call, reads what went wrong and walks you through the fix.
author: AdamDagx
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
